method_fidelity_checklist.definition: Compute diffusion map on neighborhood graph, then trace pseudotime from root cell through diffusion components
assumptions: Neighborhood graph captures local cell similarity
Diffusion components encode global trajectory structure
Root cell selection determines pseudotime origin
invariants: Requires valid neighborhood graph and diffusion map

dynamism_scoring.definition: Weighted combination of trajectory-relevant feature metrics with batch confound penalization

permutation_importance.definition: Train Random Forest on features predicting pseudotime, then measure importance by permuting each feature
